text:
alex: Heads up — after the runtime deploy at ~1752006400 I’m seeing prefix cache hit-rate drop from ~78% -> ~46% on /chat/generate (gpt-open-7b-quant). Per-token latency jumped 120ms -> 180ms. Cache lookups show a lot more misses than normal. Anyone digging?

perf-bot: profile summary (rollup):
  - window=10m, requests=48k
  - prefix_cache_hits=46%, prev=78%
  - top-miss-types: tokenizer_mismatch(29%), system_prompt_variation(22%), dynamic_metadata(16%)
  - sample_mismatch_examples in thread below.

mari: @alex thanks — I deployed the openapi-tooling/system-prompt tweak yesterday. That added a small JSON blob we inject into system message when tool integration present. Could that change keying? :thinking_face:

junaid: Quick theory: tokenizer bump last week (tokenizer v2) + system prompt tweak = different tokenized prefix -> cache key churn. If cache key uses raw prompt text vs token ids we could still be fine, but we use normalized tokens in key.

emily: I pulled 200 sample misses. Three patterns:
  1) same semantic prompt but spacing/punctuation differences from sanitizer -> different normalized tokens
  2) system prompt appended tool metadata (timestamp/nonce) not stripped -> churn
  3) tokenizer version mismatch between client-side preview and runtime (v1 vs v2) -> different tokenization length/ids

alex: sample mismatch snippet (sanitized):
```
- observed_key_tokens: [101, 24, 99, 0, ...]
- candidate_key_tokens: [101, 24, 102, 0, ...]
- prompt_text_observed: "Summarize this:  \n\nUser: What is X?"
- prompt_text_candidate: "Summarize this:\nUser: What is X?"
```
notice the tokenizer produced different token for the double newline vs single newline after normalization.

junaid: Proposed immediate mitigation: make cache key include tokenizer_version specifier and system_prompt_hash, and strip tool-runtime dynamic fields before hashing. Also add a normalization pass that: NFKC normalizes, collapses repeated whitespace, strips ephemeral tool keys (e.g., run_id, timestamp), and normalizes newlines to single "\n".

emily: Draft key function (pseudocode):
```
def make_cache_key(prompt_text, model, tokenizer_version, system_prompt, tool_meta):
    p = normalize_text(prompt_text)  # NFKC, collapse whitespace, normalize newlines
    s = strip_ephemeral(system_prompt)  # remove timestamps/nonces/tool-run ids
    tool_flag = 'tools:on' if tool_meta else 'tools:off'
    key_blob = f"model={model}|tok={tokenizer_version}|sys={sha1(s)}|tool={tool_flag}|prompt={p}"
    return sha256(key_blob)
```
This pins tokenizer_version to the key so tokenization differences produce distinct keys OR we can coerce tokenization to a canonical runner if desired.

mari: Two follow-ups: 1) including tokenizer_version in the key will prevent cross-version hits (good) but increases cold-starts when we upgrade. We should add a migration plan to warm cache after tokenizer upgrades. 2) Need to be careful: normalization must not remove semantically meaningful whitespace for some tasks.

alex: Agreed re warmup. Suggested warmup plan: when we roll tokenizer or system_prompt changes, trigger a background warmup job that replays top-K prefixes (K=50k by default) from recent production traffic into cache on new variant nodes. Also add staged canary where new keying enabled for X% traffic then ramp.

ops: For warmup job — we have a corpus export flow. I can spin a batch job that samples top prefixes and call the model to populate KV. Need a list of prefixes and a safe QPS cap.

junaid: One extra corner-case: function/tool call metadata inside the assistant messages. We currently include the full tool_call payload in prompt serialization which contains variable orderings and non-deterministic arg ordering. Need to canonicalize function args (sort keys, strip transient IDs).

emily: Also saw one regression: when we briefly enabled whitespace_collapser rule in normalizer without QA, we picked up 10% hit-rate improvement for shorter prompts but broke ones that relied on precise spacing (tabular ASCII art). Reverted. So we need a whitelist/blacklist by route or eval set.

alex: Action items:
  - @junaid: PR to add tokenizer_version and system_prompt_hash to cache key, with opt-in flag (runtime-config) + unit tests for canonicalization (due EOD Wed).
  - @emily: create normalization test matrix (preserve semantics for critical evals) + list of ephemeral fields to strip (due Thu).
  - @ops: plan warmup job + QPS cap and sample list (due Thu).
  - @mari: coord canary for system-prompt changes and flag rollout.

mari: Fine by me. I’ll also add telemetry: track "cache_key_variants" histogram so we can detect churn sources (by tokenizer_version, system_hash, tool_flag).

perf-bot: note: after reverting whitespace_collapser earlier today we regained ~6% overall hit rate in canary cluster. Keep monitoring.

alex: Thanks — tagging this for the runtime perf epics board. We’ll reconvene after PRs land. :thumbsup:
